entries.title: The Messages API can now compact a conversation on demand on the Claude API, in beta with the `compact-2026-09-04` beta header.
entries.summary: Messages API 新增按需对话压缩功能，现为测试版。

entries.title: Claude Managed Agents permission policies now include `auto`: the server evaluates each agent or MCP tool call and runs it, denies it, or pauses for your approval.
entries.summary: Managed Agents 新增 auto 权限策略，可自动评估工具调用。

entries.title: The `ant` CLI adds `ant beta:sessions connect`, which attaches your terminal to a Claude Managed Agents session.
entries.summary: ant CLI 可从终端连接、监控并审批代理会话。

entries.title: Version 1.30.0 of the `ant` CLI adds `ant apply`, which creates and updates agents, environments, skills, memory stores, and deployments from files in your repository.
entries.summary: ant CLI 1.30.0 新增资源即代码的 apply 命令。

entries.title: Per-message effort changes, in beta, are also available on Google Cloud for Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Opus 5, with the same `mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01` beta header.
entries.summary: 逐消息 effort 测试功能扩展至 Google Cloud 指定模型。

entries.title: We've launched Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`), the successor to Claude Fable 5 for long-running agentic coding, knowledge work, and research, alongside Claude Mythos 5.1 (`claude-mythos-5-1`) for Project Glasswing participants.
entries.summary: 发布 Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1，支持 1M 上下文及128K输出。

entries.title: Prompt cache reads on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $0.25 USD per million tokens: 0.025x the base input price, compared with 0.1x on other models.
entries.summary: Fable 5.1 和 Mythos 5.1 缓存读取降至每百万 token 0.25 美元。

entries.title: On Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, `tool_choice` types `any` and `tool` aren't supported and return a 400 error.
entries.summary: Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1 不支持 any、tool 两种工具选择。

entries.title: Thinking blocks produced by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are preserved only for the model that produced them or a newer one.
entries.summary: 两款 5.1 模型的思考块仅可被同代或更新模型保留读取。

entries.title: Per-message effort changes are in beta on Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Opus 5 on the Claude API.
entries.summary: Claude API 为三款模型测试逐消息调整 effort。

entries.title: Turn-scoped system messages are in beta (`mid-conversation-system-clear-at-2026-08-21` header).
entries.summary: 测试版回合范围系统消息可在下一用户消息后自动清除。

entries.title: `thinking.display` accepts a third value, `"updates"`, in beta (`thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18` header).
entries.summary: thinking.display 测试新增 updates 值以返回工具调用间进度。
